steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize the Simple Calculator project structure, creating root files and setting up the target package com.simplecalculator.app.

steps.title: Build Configuration
steps.description: Set up app/build.gradle configured for Java 17, Gradle 8.5, and Android target SDK 34 without external dependencies.

steps.title: Manifest Declaration
steps.description: Register MainActivity in the AndroidManifest.xml and establish the app name and launch icon references.

steps.title: Resource Definition
steps.description: Add default colors and application configuration string values in colors.xml and strings.xml.

steps.title: Layout Initialization
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml using a full screen vertical LinearLayout parent as a structure for the UI components.

steps.title: Display Area UI
steps.description: Implement the screen output layouts containing current expression history and result TextView fields with modern alignment.

steps.title: Button Row 1 Layout
steps.description: Establish the first row consisting of standard control keys: Clear, Backspace, Percentage, and Division in the UI.

steps.title: Button Row 2 Layout
steps.description: Add row two keys consisting of digits 7, 8, 9, and the Multiplication operator button.

steps.title: Button Row 3 Layout
steps.description: Configure row three buttons housing numeric targets 4, 5, 6, and the Subtraction operator button.

steps.title: Button Row 4 Layout
steps.description: Create the row four UI components incorporating digits 1, 2, 3, and the Addition operator button.

steps.title: Button Row 5 Layout
steps.description: Formulate the final button row providing the Sign Toggle button, Zero key, Decimal point, and Equals operator button.

steps.title: MainActivity Layout Integration
steps.description: Review and unify the entire layout file to ensure uniform weights, margins, sizes, and proper button proportions.

steps.title: Logical State Setup
steps.description: Write initial controller properties within MainActivity.java to keep track of current states, typed values, and operands.

steps.title: Digit Tapping Handlers
steps.description: Develop high-performing digit listener loops to route tapped digits into the input buffer securely and update UI screens dynamically.

steps.title: Decimal Point Handlers
steps.description: Handle formatting rules for decimal entry, preventing users from adding multiple dots in any single operand sequence.

steps.title: Operator Click Logic
steps.description: Establish sequence listeners on mathematical operands to evaluate active equations on subsequent operand triggers safely.

steps.title: Equation Evaluation Engine
steps.description: Write core execution switch-cases inside MainActivity.java to parse results of plus, minus, multiply, and division operations.

steps.title: Clear and Backspace Features
steps.description: Integrate responsive callbacks to wipe current inputs entirely or pop singular characters off the current buffer stack.

steps.title: Edge Case Handling and Formatting
steps.description: Secure safe floating decimal point division, catch division by zero limits gracefully, and trim raw values.

steps.title: Building Simple Calculator
steps.description: Consolidate and compile files to generate a clean, release-ready Simple Calculator Android APK.
